title: Grid-based procedural poster
prompt: Make a poster: a 6 by 4 grid of identical small rectangles, and the title GRID in the corner.

assertions.statement: The twenty-four cells are one source shape plus one duplicator plus one gridDistribution. A layer per cell fails.

The title is a separate text layer because its geometry and content are independent of the cells. Its node type is discovered. Catalog candidate textShape is not used until search_layer_types returns it.

Grid count is discovered before it is set. nodeDefinitions.json types gridDistribution.count as int2. The duplicator hint text calls generator.count a double2 for grids. The run must record which type the live definition returned and read the value back. Neither source is treated as settled.

hypothesis.predicted_unskilled_failure: An agent without the skill loops api.create twenty-four times and sets a guessed count type.
